title: Shopping list practicality tweaks feature root
description: Shared execution root for the shopping-list polish iteration. Coordinates focused implementation beads for aisle auto-detection, row affordance cleanup, and compact-mode settings/layout work, followed by shared testing, documentation, and review.
acceptance_criteria: All in-scope spec changes are represented by focused dependent child beads.
Implementation beads stay narrowly scoped to single changes or tightly related wiring.
Shared tester depends on every developer bead.
Shared documentation depends on every developer bead.
Shared review depends on every developer bead plus the shared tester and shared documentation beads.
